name: PR detail's Overview tab shows the degraded Blast radius marker
description: From PR #482 (the seeded acme/payments-api, whose clone_path is null and which has no repo_index_state row), the Overview tab shows the Blast radius card in its degraded state: a role=status marker naming why the map is partial ('This repository has not been indexed yet, so there is nothing to read.'), and readable empty-state copy rather than a blank box. The hermetic stack (./scripts/e2e.sh) seeds only this repo, which has no clone, so the populated-tree state (real callers/endpoints) is covered by client unit tests and the manual demo against Pereplut/dev-digest, not here. Read-only, no model call. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).

cmd: Add rate limiting to public API endpoints
steps.label: open the PR row
navigate to the PR detail route
Overview tab (the default) shows the Blast radius card (SectionLabel is CSS-uppercased, so the rendered text is upper case)
the degraded marker's label is visible

cmd: This repository has not been indexed yet, so there is nothing to read.
steps.label: the degraded marker names its reason (no_data — this repo has no clone_path)
the empty-state title renders beneath the marker (no callers, not a blank box)
